title: Complete reducibility of finite-dimensional finite-group representations
statement: Let $F$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $G$ be a finite group, and let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $F$-vector space with an action $\rho:G\to\operatorname{GL}_F(V)$. There are an integer $r\geq0$, nonzero $G$-stable subspaces $V_1,\ldots,V_r\subseteq V$, each having no nonzero proper $G$-stable subspace, and a $G$-equivariant $F$-linear isomorphism $V\simeq\bigoplus_{j=1}^r V_j$. The empty direct sum is allowed when $V=0$.
